data.content:
Coded Culinary

Home | Recipes | About

Blueberry Scones

A delightful, tender scone bursting with fresh blueberries, perfect for breakfast or tea time.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, pat into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips

For best results, keep butter and cream cold. Do not overmix the dough to ensure tender scones.

© 2025 Coded Culinary. All recipes tested in our kitchen.

data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Flaky, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries

This classic recipe yields tender, lightly sweetened scones perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea. The blueberries add a pop of color and natural sweetness.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 7-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
  8. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool slightly before serving.

Nutrition Info (per scone)

Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g

© 2026 Coded Culinary. Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - CodedCulinary
data.content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

A delicious, tender scone bursting with fresh blueberries. Perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

Yield: 8 scones

Preparation time: 15 minutes

Baking time: 20 minutes

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Coded Culinary

Home | Recipes | About

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place scones on prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tip: For extra sweetness, brush tops with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking.

Related Recipes

  • Lemon Scones
  • Chocolate Chip Scones

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - Code'd Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

These blueberry scones are buttery, tender, and bursting with fresh blueberries. Perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea.

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 2 teaspoons baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
5. Gently fold wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Fold in blueberries.
7. Shape dough into a circle, cut into 8 wedges, and place on baking sheet.
8. Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.

Total Time: 35 minutes
Servings: 8

Note: Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Coded Culinary

Home | Recipes | About

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place scones on prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tip: For extra sweetness, brush tops with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking.

Related Recipes

Blueberry Scones

Home | Recipes | About

  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

For best results, use cold ingredients and handle the dough minimally to keep scones tender. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

data.content:
Fluffy Blueberry Scones

A delightful baked treat with fresh blueberries and a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries and lemon zest.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, cream, and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden.
  8. Cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with lemon glaze.

Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - CodedCulinary
data.content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

A delicious, tender scone bursting with fresh blueberries. Perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

Yield: 8 scones

Preparation time: 15 minutes

Baking time: 20 minutes

  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place scones on prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tip: For extra sweetness, brush tops with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking.

Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Home | Recipes | About

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

For best results, use cold ingredients and handle the dough minimally to keep scones tender. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Coded Culinary

Home | Recipes | About

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place scones on prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tip: For extra sweetness, brush tops with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking.

Related Recipes

  • Lemon Scones
  • Chocolate Chip Scones

Coded Culinary

Home | Recipes | About

Blueberry Scones

A delightful, tender scone bursting with fresh blueberries, perfect for breakfast or tea time.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, pat into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips

For best results, keep butter and cream cold. Do not overmix the dough to ensure tender scones.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Home | Recipes | About

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Optional: coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

For best results, use cold ingredients and handle the dough minimally to keep scones tender. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.content:
Fluffy Blueberry Scones

A delightful baked treat with fresh blueberries and a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries and lemon zest.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, cream, and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden.
  8. Cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with lemon glaze.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - CodedCulinary
data.content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

A delicious, tender scone bursting with fresh blueberries. Perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

Yield: 8 scones

Preparation time: 15 minutes

Baking time: 20 minutes

data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutes

Cook Time: 20 minutes

Total Time: 35 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
